messages.subject: DIC isue
parts:
Dear Prof. Rue

I would like to ask why the DIC is not similar for every time I run a similar model especially for "nbmodel". I always get different DIC. 
is this because of the numerical approximation?

Thank you very much

Best regards
Mindra

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] DIC isue
parts:
This is due to parallel computing that does not give the same answer for
every run (basically, initial values depends on the current thread, and
then its gets all random).

you can reduce the effect using the most recent testing version and R-
4.0

if you set num.threads="1:1" it runs in serial and it should be the
same

if you use control.inla=list(tolerance=1e-10), then differences should
be less.

H
